Language: English  
  
Description:  
This is a side-story in Rance series, released shortly after the fourth game, but dedicated to an entirely different quest. All kinds of troubles are happening to a factory where a new Happiness Medicine is being developed. The mercenary Rance is hired by the manager to investigate the source of these troubles. First task: clear the factory of the monsters...  
  
This is a RPG with turn-based combat and strong adventure elements (menu with command verbs such as "Examine", "Talk", etc., at every given screen). Unlike the previous Rance games, the battles do not allow free movement on the screen, and are carried out in a more traditional Japanese-style way. There is no physical movement in the game; hostile areas (dungeons) are also explored by choosing menu commands. As in all other Rance games, there are explicit sex scenes in this game.  
  
**Important:**  
You can run this version on 64-bit operating systems. You need Oracle VirtualBox or VMware Player in order to play the game.  
  
I. Within VirtualBox, do “File > Import Appliance” and select the file “Rance41 VM.ova".  
  
II. Within VMware Player( In some cases Rance runs too slow on VirtualBox. It runs much faster using VMware Player and it is possible to enable the sound.):  
1. Player > Manage > Virtual Machine Settings  
2. In the hardware tab click add and add your sound device.  
3. Restart the Rance VM.  
4. In the desktop, right clik > Setup > Utility > Multiple Sound Card Wizard. Choose the right card (I chose the first one).  
5. Restart the VM.  
6. At the bottom of the VM in the taskbar there should be a Winamp icon. Right click it > Options > Preferences > Output.  
7. I chose Output:default for both plugins. Don’t forget to click Apply and check enable.  
8. On the speaker icon. Right click it and choose Full Window. Check PCM and raise the volume.  
  
!!!If you encounter Kernal Panics error check your bios to see if the VTX or VTM option is enabled.

\[About Ryojoku Quest\]  
 This isn't just another porn quest!   
 Stamina-curry presents a robust, full RPG  
 with proper production values and gameplay!   
 It's not hard, but even if bosses mess you up,   
 you can level up and re-battle   
 for the sake of the next ero scene!   
  
 \[No Generic Art!\]   
 This isn't some template RPG Maker / Wolf Editor game!   
 We used exactly ZERO prefab royalty-free imagery.   
 Ryojoku Quest is built from scratch!   
  
 Check out the side view battle action! :)   
  
 \[The Fabled Rise of a Hero...ine\]   
 Young girl Artha is at her wits end. Cursed by the lust of In-ghoul Rimul,   
 Artha fights the despair and embarks on a quest to defeat him.   
 With the help of the ghost of her grandfather, Artha will brave the perilous   
 way, making unlikely friendships with Petty the Littleperson and Ilma the Demoness,   
 slaying any enemy who gets between themselves and the goal   
 to break Rimul's curse and save the people---!  
  
 \[Copious Content\]   
 More than 10 erotic scenes! All voiced!

 徐々に淫魔化する呪いをかけられ絶望するも、祖父の霊の手助けで淫魔討伐の旅に出向く。  
 そして道中に出会った小人族のペティや魔女のイルマと共に、三人で困難の道のりを歩む事に。  
 自身にかけられた呪いを解き、近隣の村々を救うため、阻む敵を屈服させろ――!

Description:  
Rance 4.2: Angel-gumi is the second part of the story that began in Rance 4.1: O-Kusuri Koujou o Sukue! rather than an all-new Rance adventure. The hero continues to investigate the weird occurrences connected to the Happiness Medicine Factory. Since the story picks up directly where it ended in the sequel, Rance begins his adventure already commanding an all-female squad called the Angel Team.  
  
Nothing has changed gameplay-wise; as before, interaction with the game world is done through menu commands everywhere, including dungeons. The combat system has also remained exactly the same as in predecessor.  
  
**Important:**  
!!!Rance 4.2 is kind of an odd game in that it’s a 16-bit program for Windows 3.1, and when Microsoft made their 64-bit operating systems, they decided to remove support for running 16-bit programs.  
  
1. If you don't already have inmm.dll installed, use the included installer \_inmm238.exe for it. Otherwise, the music won't run.  
2. Run Launcher.exe, not SYSTEM3.EXE.

 ある日世界を覆っていた結界が解け、異世界の強力な夢魔が大挙して湧き出てきた。  
 現れた夢魔達は冒険者の集う町、ユージットを一夜にして占拠してしまう。  
 ユージット占拠の報を受けたグライドは事態の重大さなどツユ知らず、夢魔退治の依頼をホイホイ引き受け  
 相棒のマリナを引き連れてユージットへと向かうのだった……  
  
 ■戦闘は全てセックスバトル■  
 互いに快感を与えあいイかせあうオーソドックスなBFRPGです、  
 レベルを上げ、スキルを習得し、主人公グライドを強化していきましょう。  
  
 ■射精=負けじゃない■  
 本作ではVP制を採用しており、射精するとVPが減少、VPが0になった時点で敗北となります。  
 多少の射精は問題なく、戦闘後のVP回復も容易なため、ほどほどに射精を楽しみながらダンジョンを探索できます。  
  
 ■再戦も状況再現も楽に可能■  
 本作では攻略したダンジョンに出る敵と再戦可能な夢魔研究ノートが用意されています。  
 ノート内にはデバッグ部屋もあり、好みの状況をらくらく再現できます。  
  
 ■充実したテキスト■  
 特にボス戦においてテキストが充実しています、敵からの性技による射精時は勿論  
 敵へのトドメ時も愛撫絶頂・ピストン絶頂・自ピストン始動の同時絶頂・敵ピストン始動の同時絶頂等多彩な  
 テキストが用意されています、是非回想戦などを利用して全てご覧下さい。  
  
 ※本作は旧作、「アネットとベスティの日々」・「グライドの日々」と世界観を共有しています。  
 BFを楽しむ上では本作のみで問題ありませんが、旧作をプレイしているとストーリーを理解しやすくなります。  
 旧作のあらすじやDL先については体験版付属のテキストをご覧下さい。

 したらばの掲示板に行き説明を見てください。

**Description**  
In a parallel world, the history takes a different turn at the start of the 20th Century. Black death plague ravages the European Countries, death toll is so high that when the Ottoman Empire strikes from the east they are powerless to resist. In the name of Jihad, Europe burns.  
  
Kuu Klein is the only survivor of black death in his village in Germany and he flees all the way to Beijing to survive the war and the plague. He has the ability to read minds but it brings him only more suffering.  
  
Ten years later, when the World War starts chaos and poverty spreads to Beijing. He decides to go back to his hometown, better to be at home if the war will be everywhere... But there are no trains to Europe except the rumored "Black Train Joan". He tries to get on that train but the only people with the "Black Ticket" are allowed to board.  
  
Unable to find a way to get abroad he gives himself to alcohol, later that day on the street he meets a girl who offers him a black ticket. Somehow he can't read the thoughts of this particular girl. She can't speak a word either, an another strange thing about her is that she covers her hands with long dark gloves, never taking them off for any reason...  
  
After some difficulty in conversation, he learns that her name is Emma and she would give him a ticket if he agrees to travel to Europe as her companion. They board the train together and take of on a journey that will take them over seven bridges and many ordeals...
